ov: بين الرغبة وعدم اليقين (الفرنسية: Entre Désir et incertitude) هو فيلم وثائقي مغربي صدرَ عام 2010 من إخراجِ المخرج عبد القادر لقطع.
plotEn: This is the first documentary film dedicated to Moroccan cinema; Between Desire and Uncertainty hands the microphone over to the filmmakers and film critics. Besides offering a brief historical approach, this documentary strives to identify the different movements that push Moroccan cinema. Likewise, it also makes very clear the dangers that threaten cinema's evolution.
